instruction: Fix `median` so it returns the average of the two middle elements for even-length inputs instead of only the upper-middle element.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/numstats.py b/numstats.py
--- a/numstats.py
+++ b/numstats.py
@@ -10,6 +10,8 @@
     """Return the median of ``values``."""
     s = sorted(values)
     n = len(s)
+    if n % 2 == 0:
+        return (s[n // 2 - 1] + s[n // 2]) / 2
     return s[n // 2]
